jobs.description: IT Jobs, Insurance Regulatory Authority Jobs. The Information Communication Technology Officer manages IT systems and infrastructure, requiring a Bachelor’s in Computer Science, IT, Information Systems, BBIT, or Telecommunication Engineering. Full-time role in Nairobi.
responsibilities: Assisting users in complying with the ICT Policies, Strategies, Standards and Procedures;
Assisting in the ICT working tools, deliveries, setup and configurations and issuing;
Undertaking the maintenance and support of ICT infrastructure, systems and software.
Identifying ICT infrastructure and equipment due for replacement and disposal;
Undertaking end-user training on use of ICT infrastructure, systems and software;
Implementing cyber security controls and monitoring their effectiveness;
requirements: Bachelors degree in any of the following: Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Business Information Technology, Telecommunication Engineering or equivalent qualification from a recognized institution.
Proficiency in computer applications.
